name: Mrs. Birmire
source:
The mother of Virgil and Victor Birmire.
After the accident, Mrs. Birmire has been working as hard as she can to pay for Victor's medical expenses. The pressure often overwhelms her, causing her to consume more alcohol.

[From [url=http://www.thanatoscontract.godsibb.net/mom.html]Official Site[/url]]
